blocks.text: SAO PAULO–Lewis Hamilton said on Thursday he remained frustrated by events at Ferrari during last week’s Formula One Mexico City Grand Prix and had yet to hold any discussions about the opening-lap clash that wrecked their victory hopes. Speaking in the Interlagos paddock ahead of this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix, the 41-year-old explained that team boss Fred Vasseur had returned to Italy between the races.
